{{Quote|The 18-month-long dispute between Viper Sensor Intelligence Systems and Arakyd Industries is now resolved following the Arakyd assault and takeover of the VSIS headquarters.|"Sensor Technology Dispute Settled in Takeover"|<ref name="Sensor Technology Dispute Settled in Takeover" />}}
'''Viper Tower''' was located in [[Hpaq]], a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]]. It was headquarters of [[Viper Sensor Intelligence Systems]]<ref name="Sensor Technology Dispute Settled in Takeover" /> and home to its Vulpter-based offices.<ref name="AAD-4">{{DB|droid|aad4|AAD-4}}</ref> Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|4|AAD-4}}</ref> 60 [[AAD-4 assault droid]]s belonging to VSIS competitor [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] entered Viper Tower just prior to the end of the business day and quickly eliminated its ground-floor security units. The remaining Viper staff were relocated to the testing wing while three [[XR-37]] [[Droid tank/Legends|droid tanks]] obliterated the building's top floors, which housed accounting and administrative divisions. Arakyd's assault on Viper Tower resolved an 18-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] dispute between the two companies, with the former successfully taking over VSIS and keeping it in operation as a research-and-development division. A [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] remained at VSIS headquarters in order to assist with the transition.<ref name="Sensor Technology Dispute Settled in Takeover" />

==Behind the scenes==
Viper Tower was originally created for ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50]]'', a [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]] with illustrations by [[Joe Corroney]] and released on [[April 4]], [[2002]].<ref name="Sensor Technology Dispute Settled in Takeover" />
